text:
Priya G.: Quick flag — the 'Alpha/Beta' price sheet rollout started 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC and we see ~60 accounts in the beta cohort picked up new per-unit tiers instead of being grandfathered. Not all of these should have moved. Spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/finance/price-alpha-beta (view).

Omar L.: ugh. which filter did the rollout use? cohort key or account_tag?

Priya G.: rollout used cohort_tag but the grandfathering rule expects billing_plan_id at the account level. Suspect mapping mismatch in the price-mapper job.

Jordan M.: I pulled logs from price-mapper-run-20260401: shows mapping.version=3 and transform: map(account.owner_id -> billing_plan_id) returned null for ~12% which then defaulted to new-tier.

Jordan M.: log excerpt:
```
2026-04-01T08:59:12Z INFO price-mapper v3 starting
2026-04-01T09:00:05Z WARN missing billing_plan_id for account=acc_442
2026-04-01T09:00:06Z INFO apply_new_price(account=acc_442, plan=beta)
```

Billing Ops: We need to know whether these were charged yet. If invoices generated, we can't mutate past invoices beyond 30 days w/out legal sign-off.

finance-bot: Billing run check: 60 accounts in question; 18 invoices generated (invoice_ts between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-02). Audit ref: https://ops.redwood/audit/FIN-4930.

Priya G.: Proposed immediate steps: 1) PAUSE remaining rollout, 2) revert mapper to v2, 3) run remap job to tag affected accounts as 'grandfathered', 4) create credit memos for invoices in range and notify customers. Need Legal + Billing Ops approval for memos > $2k.

Legal: note — for invoice edits older than 45 days we require signed approval from CRO. Under 45 days, credit memo is fine with finance lead sign-off. Also check T&Cs clause 4.3 before automated notice.

Omar L.: I'll prepare v2 rollback patch and a tight unit test for the mapper. Also adding a check: if billing_plan_id is null, don't default to new-tier; instead route to review queue. Patch diff snippet:
```
- if missing(billing_plan_id): default = new_tier
+ if missing(billing_plan_id): route = review_queue; alert = true
```

VendorSyncBot: FYI vendor-pricing-feed delayed by ~2hrs on 2026-04-01; some accounts had stale pricing metadata. Link: https://vendors.redwood/sync/2026-04-01.

Jordan M.: that matches. Stale feed + mapper v3 = double fault. I'm launching a remap dry-run on 100 accounts to confirm idempotency. Query used: 
```
SELECT account_id, original_price, applied_price, billing_plan_id
FROM price_application
WHERE run_id = 'price-mapper-20260401' AND account_tag = 'beta'
LIMIT 100;
```

Billing Ops: we'll assemble a customer notification template. If any customer exposure >$5k, we'll route to AMs for manual outreach first.

Priya G.: I'll open FIN-4930 and assign owners. Action owners: Omar -> rollback & unit test; Jordan -> remap dry-run & verification; Billing Ops -> invoice list + memos; Legal -> approval path. Scheduling incident sync 11:30 PT in #release-war-room.

finance-bot: Dry-run results posted to FIN-4930: remap idempotent for sample; 14 accounts flagged needing manual review. Checksum b7e9f2. Full remap scheduled in 40 minutes pending rollback.

Priya G.: thanks team. After remap we'll re-run canary with a stricter preflight (feed freshness check + non-null billing_plan_id). Will update release board and customer comms. :rocket:
